title: Aina za nomino (Theme 1: Mapishi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks "is this the name of one particular person, place or thing?" and writes it with a capital.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the noun in a sentence.
floor.question: Nomino ni ipi: "Mama anapika."

representations: a map of Kenya with towns and rivers
name cards: Tana / mto, Kisumu / mji
steps: Ask: is it the name of one particular one?

board.say: Lipi ni jina la mto mmoja maalum?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts six words into pekee and kawaida and writes two sentences with a capital for each pekee.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mto ___ ni mrefu kuliko mito yote nchini Kenya." Kwa nini "maji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Neno hilo ni jina la jumla la kitu cha aina hiyo. Nomino ya pekee ni jina la kipekee, kama Tana au Nairobi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwalimu mkuu wetu anaitwa ___." Kwa nini "mwalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mwalimu ni cheo au kazi, na watu wengi wanaweza kuwa walimu. Jina la mtu, kama Kamau, ndiyo nomino ya pekee.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwalimu alimpa Wanjiru kitabu. Nomino ya pekee ni ipi?" Kwa nini "Mwalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata kama neno la kwanza ni nomino ya kawaida. Tafuta jina la mtu au mahali.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "nairobi" ni jina la mahali gani? Linaanzaje?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya pekee huanza kwa herufi kubwa popote ilipo katika sentensi.

checks.question: Ni nomino ipi ya pekee: mji, Nakuru, soko?
Andika vizuri: rafiki yangu ni otieno.
